caption: The drawing consists of a symmetrical arrangement of floral and fruit-like objects rendered in gold on a black background. The central area contains two large, round objects with a single wide stripe in the center, resembling stylized melons or gourds. On either side of the central objects are two slightly smaller, round objects with segmented sections, suggesting another type of fruit or vegetable. There are also two oval shapes with diagonal grid-like patterns, resembling a basket weave. These central objects are surrounded by a variety of stylized flowers, including several large daisy-like blossoms with multiple petals and prominent central disks, as well as smaller round flowers and numerous leaves. The composition is dense, with the flowers, leaves, and fruits filling most of the available space, all depicted in the same iridescent gold color against a solid black background.
title: Hitchcock Chair
